AGENDA
  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  March 25, 2021

Meeting Place:  Call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
  Meeting ID: 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281

Call to Order:  2:00 p.m.

Roll Call

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any item on the agenda may
do so at this time.

Approval of the minutes of the Special Meetings held on February 25, 2021.

Permit (s):

Item #1:  Miles Canares DBA Family Style Food Festival, LLC to host a Family Style &
  Blondie Beach’s Drive- In Movie event at 3695 Pincay Drive (SoFi Stadium Lot N)
  between March 26, 2021- March 28, 2021 from 6:00 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. (Activity
  No. 00318951)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Halimah Ginyard DBA Inglewood Chamber of Commerce to host an Inglewood
  City of Champions 5k Run / Walk at 3400 W. Arbor Vitae St. (Darby Park) between
  April 09, 2021 - April 11, 2021, from 8:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m. (Activity No. 00318949)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business
not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

Adjournment
